# Building Developer Tools

Developer tools—linters, scaffolding engines, formatters, and code generators—require specialized features: generating shell auto-completion scripts, synthesizing man pages, and running interactive prompts.

## Dynamic Shell Auto-Completion with `clap_complete`

Users expect tab-completion for subcommands, flags, and file paths across `bash`, `zsh`, `fish`, and `powershell`. `clap_complete` generates these completion scripts directly from your `clap` definition:

```toml
[dependencies]
clap = { version = "4.5", features = ["derive"] }
clap_complete = "4.5"
```

```rust
use clap::{Command, CommandFactory, Parser, Subcommand};
use clap_complete::{generate, Shell};
use std::io;

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "mydevtool")]
struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    command: Commands,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum Commands {
    /// Generate shell auto-completions
    Completions {
        #[arg(value_enum)]
        shell: Shell,
    },
    /// Format codebase
    Format,
    /// Lint source files
    Lint,
}

fn print_completions(shell: Shell, cmd: &mut Command) {
    generate(shell, cmd, cmd.get_name().to_string(), &mut io::stdout());
}

fn main() {
    let cli = Cli::parse();

    match cli.command {
        Commands::Completions { shell } => {
            let mut cmd = Cli::command();
            print_completions(shell, &mut cmd);
        }
        Commands::Format => println!("Formatting code..."),
        Commands::Lint => println!("Linting code..."),
    }
}
```

A user can install completions into their shell environment with:

```bash
mydevtool completions zsh > ~/.zsh/completion/_mydevtool
```

## Interactive Inquirer Prompts with `inquire`

When users omit required parameters, prompt them interactively:

```toml
[dependencies]
inquire = "0.7"
```

```rust
use inquire::{Select, Text, Confirm};

fn prompt_project_scaffolding() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let project_name = Text::new("Project name:")
        .with_default("my-service")
        .prompt()?;

    let language = Select::new(
        "Choose primary language template:",
        vec!["Rust (Tokio)", "Rust (WASM)", "Rust (CLI)"],
    ).prompt()?;

    let initialize_git = Confirm::new("Initialize git repository?")
        .with_default(true)
        .prompt()?;

    println!("Scaffolding {project_name} ({language}) with Git: {initialize_git}");
    Ok(())
}
```
